task_completion.description: Load both the CT and MRI datasets into the Weasis viewer simultaneously.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the Weasis interface with both CT and MRI series listed in the thumbnails panel or displayed in the workspace.

task_completion.description: Configure the viewer layout to show CT and MRI images side-by-side for comparison.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A split-screen or multi-view layout in Weasis showing a CT slice and an MRI slice at the same time.

task_completion.description: Apply a bone window setting to the CT image for assessment.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The CT image appears with high contrast/brightness settings typical of bone windows (e.g., WL: 300-500, WW: 1500-2000), making cortical bone clearly visible.

task_completion.description: Perform a measurement of the same anatomical structure on both the CT and MRI images.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Measurement lines (calipers) with numerical values (e.g., in mm) visible on both the CT and MRI views in the Weasis workspace.

task_completion.description: Export the annotated views as PNG files to the specified export directory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent navigating the 'Export' or 'Save As' dialog in Weasis, targeting /home/ga/DICOM/exports/ct_crossmod.png and mr_crossmod.png.

task_completion.description: Create a text report containing measurements, percentage difference, and diagnostic commentary.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal view showing the content of /home/ga/DICOM/exports/crossmodality_report.txt with the required numerical data and comparative text.

integrity.description: Verify the agent used the Weasis GUI for measurements rather than just generating a text file via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots must show the mouse cursor interacting with Weasis measurement tools and the viewer interface.

integrity.description: Ensure the measurements in the report match the values visible on the Weasis screen annotations.
integrity.visual_evidence: The numerical values in the final .txt report should correspond to the labels on the calipers in the exported .png images.

integrity.description: Check that the commentary on diagnostic advantages is specific to the modalities and not generic filler text.
integrity.visual_evidence: The report text should mention specific characteristics like CT's bone detail versus MRI's soft tissue contrast.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must use Weasis to load CT data from /home/ga/DICOM/studies/crossmod_ct/ and MRI data from /home/ga/DICOM/studies/crossmod_mr/. It must use a bone window for CT. The final outputs must be two PNGs (ct_crossmod.png, mr_crossmod.png) and one text report (crossmodality_report.txt) in /home/ga/DICOM/exports/. The report must contain: 1) CT measurement, 2) MRI measurement, 3) Percentage difference, 4) Commentary on CT vs MRI advantages.
